notes.title: ALPHA 3.0 RELEASE!
notes.content:
[b]PATCH NOTES[/b]

Added Smart AI for side characters (Not just Creej)
Added An Advanced Police AI built off of the current AI
Creej Now has a new special ability- Lockdown, Which will lock all his house exits when being chased
Remade Almost all of the lore and story
Remade the progression
NEW AI MECHANIC- They can close doors on you to slow you down
New Custom Catch animations for all characters
New Zorden Chase Music
Each AI Now hears every door you open, everytime you fall, and every loud footstep or noise you make
Remade the Door opening mechanic for AI and changed a bit of it for the player
Full tutorial to the game added
Full introduction added
Remade the Dreamworld Garage Minigame
Intro Cutscene Added
Ending Cutscene Added
Ending Added
Dreamworld Added
Lots or Story and lore added
Police station location added
Police AI added
More Foliage has been placed around the map
New Background Houses
Some new trees placed
More Detail in houses
Zorden's House has new textures
Texture quality for lots of textures has been improved
Fixed Dashing and jumping being able to fly
Lots of New puzzles have been added
A way to complete the game is here
Some NPC's will get tired now when you run for long enough
Better motion blur
Fixed some roads dissapearing on the edges
Reoptimized the game again
Reduced Lots of Foliage Pop-In
Added a new lore page for Zorden

notes.title: ALPHA 2.9 | Quality Of Life Update
notes.content:
Remade Lighting and brightness for a darker atmosphere inside houses
Edited Creejs AI again fixing some navigation errors allowing him to chase you longer and easier
Lowered Beurden's Navigation area, to prevent him from leaving his house
Fixed many map errors such as floating foliage and roads
Made the Dreamworld monster a bit faster
Increased Texture quality overall
Remade the gift shop puzzle
Remade the Car's Camera
Retextured the car
Fixed the Minimap not changing when player is using the car
Fixed AI being able to chase the player when in the car
Edited the effects for running, Dodging, and chasing
New fall damage system with new animations
Overall stability improvements and bug fixes to prepare the game for its biggest update, 3.0!

notes.title: ALPHA 2.8 RELEASE
notes.content:
Since 3.0 Will be the last alpha, The map has reduced in size, fixing Low VRAM crashes, And general optimization.

Fixed MAJOR bug with Creej's Ai causing his jumpscare to be off-centered
Edited Creej's AI to make him faster and smarter
Edited Creej's Catching code, He will now catch you quicker from behind and make you jump
Fixed Texture streaming breaking for some people
Fixed Weather never changing from light rain
Lighting is more consistent and doesnt pop in as much
LODs for outside and inside have increased distance on higher settings
Made texture quality for some things higher
Added a player animation for opening a door
Fixed the car sometimes not spawning when pressing L
Fixed the dreamworld cutscene from not starting for some people


If you have any suggestions, please be sure to join our discord server and ask me! You can also put suggestions in there which are always looked at by developers. Enjoy 2.8 guys!

notes.title: ALPHA 2.7 | ANIMATION UPDATE
notes.content:
Added new animations for everyone
Added smoother animations for everyone
Creej has a diving animation before his catching animation
Fixed bugs with catching animations being offcentered
Fixed some clipping issues with Creejs Clipping animation
Optimized the game even more!
Fixed all bugs known from 2.6

notes.title: 2.6.1 Optimization and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Majorly Optimized weather

Gave the graphics menu lower graphics options

Gave the graphics menu higher graphics options

Increased Draw distance for some graphics options

Added some detail and fixed some terrain bugs

notes.title: ALPHA 2.6 RELEASE!
notes.content:
IMPROVEMENTS

Flashlight Is improved and doesn't go through the player if you look down

New Camera shake system along with new walking and running Animations, Once again.

Stamina improved

New Chase Effect, More intense but better visibility

Fixed some Text placement issues

Added Streetlights that turn off when day and turn on when night

Optimized the weather a bit more

There is an effect when dodging

Major detail added to the Creej Residence

Some Changes to audio

Changes To Creej's AI to make him scarier

Catching is quicker and less annoying




Please let us know what you would like to see in 2.7!

notes.title: 2.5.1 Day 1 Patch
notes.content:
Edited UI for 2.5
Fixed a crashing on startup issue
Lowered the volume of weather effects

notes.title: WEATHER UPDATE | ALPHA 2.5
notes.content:
IMPROVEMENTS

Added a dynamic weather system that will include rain, snow, thunder, hail, ice, wind, and lots of variations of them.

Added outside ambience

Brightened the lighting inside all houses

Changed lighting a bit inside all houses

Added shadows to a lot more lights without ruining fps

Optimized weather

Weather doesnt go through roofs anymore

Changed some footsteps

Completely remade outside lighting

Changed AI to work as much as possible

Made AI Animations way smoother

Remade the entire car mechanic

Added particles without ruining fps

Added some RTX mirrors without ruining fps
